page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. This KVM-hypervised instance features 12 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a 1:1 mapping of vCPUs to physical cores. The hardware configuration includes 24.0 GB of system memory, which yields a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance trade-off between single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. Single-core performance is relatively limited, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression falls into the bottom 10%. However, the 12 dedicated physical cores compensate in parallelized tasks, elevating multi-core stress-ng CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and PassMark CPU scores to average levels. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small and large blocks also perform in the middle tier, though the overall PassMark memory score remains in the bottom 25%.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Factual performance metrics show average throughput for Redis SET operations and PassMark database operations, alongside average prompt processing speeds for small 135M parameter language models. Conversely, static web serving throughput is weak, and medium 7B parameter model inference speeds are poor to weak. This profile makes the instance suitable for multi-threaded batch processing, distributed computing nodes, and moderate database operations, offering a balanced resource-to-compute profile for parallel tasks without the overhead of unused memory or local storage.
